name: devc-bridge (container client)
description: Installs the devc-bridge client so a devcontainer can invoke allowlisted commands on the host. Downloads the Linux client from the matching devc-tools release and puts `devc-bridge` on PATH. The host bridge must be installed, and the token bind mount is declared by your devcontainer.json — see the README.

clientVersion.description: Release version of the Linux client to install. Empty means the devc-tools release this Feature pins (DEVC_TOOLS_RELEASE in its install.sh), which is not the same thing as this Feature's own version — the two move independently.
